slice: FULL SAIL Stage 1 NIGHTWATCH Ch4 Slice B4

findings.red: On 9c1fdba3, B3 computes staff-safe would_send after claim/load/recover but stores nothing. 085 is producer-time policy audit, 086 is claim/lease identity, 092 is reconstitution material, 070 reply approvals are a distinct staff operation_id, and 078 outbound approvals are conversation-level without inbound_event_id. Restart, JSON projection, or a later HTTP path can lose or forge the comparison.
findings.green: One append-only shadow-outcome owner persists exact operation + capturing claim lease + issuance + tenant/location/conversation/inbound/recipient digest + policy versions. It stores derived luna_decision=would_send and comparison_state=pending_human only. Caller cannot select would_send, reason, versions, human outcome, comparison result, or identities.

findings.red: Successful B3 would_send remains claimed. Lease expiry reclaim increments attempt_count and can hit attempt_cap. Misusing journal handoff_established would mint send-capable identity. Cancel is the wrong semantic.
findings.green: Atomic current-lease CAS capture inserts the outcome and transitions claimed→shadow_captured (lease released, handoff_id null, attempt_count unchanged). Restart/replay returns the same outcome. Stale owners cannot overwrite. Attempts do not increment after successful capture. Zero journal rows.

findings.red: Absence of a staff send is not disagreement. Conversation-only 078 rows and duplicate 070 approvals cannot bind a unique human action. Caller-selected human_action_id or rebound conversation/inbound/recipient would fake agreement.
findings.green: Capture stores pending_human with null human identity. A deterministic later-match contract reads tenant_email_reply_approvals by exact client/location/endpoint/conversation/source_inbound_event_id and approved|terminal only. Zero matches stay pending_human. One unique match is agreement. Duplicates are excluded. Rebound inbound/conversation/location/endpoint is invalid. Disagreement is not grounded and is never inferred from absence.

findings.red: A generic truthy env coerce or require() from staff-query-api / Luna runtime composition would activate comparison or treat it as send.
findings.green: Default-off, import-inert, start-inert. No Graph/SMTP/nodemailer/send callback. staff-query-api, docker compose, and Luna runtime composition do not import or start the owner. Staff-safe projection hides raw UUIDs, recipient digest, secrets, and internal errors.
